link.lost: Connection to the PC was lost. Retrying. Transfers continue where they stopped.

needToken.title: Scan the QR code on your PC
needToken.body: Open Veydrop on your PC, go to Connect Device, then scan the QR code with this phone's camera.
needToken.hint: Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi network.

waiting.title: Approve this phone on your PC
waiting.body: {{pc}} is asking you to confirm. Check that it shows this code, then approve.

rejected.title: Request declined
rejected.body: The PC declined this phone. Scan a new QR code to try again.

expired.title: Request timed out
expired.body: Nobody approved this phone in time. Scan a new QR code to try again.

pairing_expired.title: QR code expired
pairing_expired.body: This code is no longer valid. Generate a new QR code on your PC and scan it.

pairing_used.title: QR code already used
pairing_used.body: Each QR code works once. Generate a new QR code on your PC and scan it.

network.title: Can't reach your PC
network.body: Make sure this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the PC, and that Veydrop is still running.

other.title: Couldn't connect
other.body: Something went wrong while pairing. Generate a new QR code on your PC and scan it.

send.title: Send to PC
send.desc: Choose photos, videos or files on this phone.

receive.title: Receive from PC
receive.desc: Download the files your PC is sharing.

send.title: Send to PC
send.intro: Pick what to send. Your PC will ask you to accept it before anything is saved.
send.waiting: Waiting for your PC to accept…
send.offerFailed: Your PC could not accept these files.
send.tooMany: Too many files at once. Send up to {{n}} at a time.
send.keepOpen: Keep this page open while sending. If the screen locks, the transfer pauses and continues when you come back.

receive.title: Receive from PC

empty.title: Nothing shared yet
empty.body: On your PC, open Send Files, choose files or folders and start sharing. They will appear here.

receive.missing: No longer available on the PC
receive.noteIos: On iPhone, Safari saves downloads to the Files app. Tap the download icon in the address bar to open them.
receive.noteAndroid: On Android, your browser saves downloads to its download folder. Check the notification or the Files app.
receive.noteGeneric: Your browser decides where downloads are saved. Veydrop cannot choose that location.

ended.title: Connection ended
ended.body: This phone is no longer connected to the PC. Scan a new QR code to connect again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageFollows: Follows the language chosen in Veydrop on your PC.
settings.notice: This connection is plain HTTP on your local network, so it is not encrypted. Use it only on a Wi-Fi network you trust.

errors.io: A file operation failed on the PC. Check that its disk is available and try again.
errors.permission_denied: The PC was not allowed to save to that location.
errors.path_not_found: That file or folder no longer exists.
errors.port_in_use: The PC's port is in use by another program.
errors.not_found: That item could not be found. It may have been removed.
errors.conflict: That action conflicts with the current state. Try again.
errors.unauthorized: This phone is no longer connected. Scan the QR code again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Generate a new QR code on your PC.
errors.pairing_used: That pairing code was already used. Generate a new QR code on your PC.
errors.server_not_running: The PC is not sharing right now.
errors.no_network: The PC has no usable network connection.
errors.insufficient_space: The PC does not have enough free disk space for this transfer.
errors.too_large: That file is larger than the limit set on the PC.
errors.hash_mismatch: The file arrived damaged: its checksum did not match, so the PC discarded it.
errors.offset_mismatch: The transfer lost sync and could not continue.
errors.zip_too_large: That selection is too large for a single ZIP. Download files individually.
errors.network: Can't reach the PC. Check that both devices are on the same Wi-Fi.
errors.file_changed: This file changed while it was being sent. Select it again.
